description:
It was a miserable day.  
She lived a life where she could not die.  
Rat, who lived in the slums, was in danger of being sold to a perverted nobleman.

“P-please save me…!”

Her first attempt at rebellion was easily thwarted, and she wondered if she would die like this.

“You’re safe now.”

She is saved by a man she meets for the first time.  
And a fantasy-like life is given to her.  
She gets to know her parents, who she thought never existed, and reclaims her real name, Irina.  
Among the kind-hearted people of the Winfried family, Irina heals her wounds and grows little by little.

“Miss Irina, make sure you’re happy here.”

The man who saved her, Duke Logan Winfried.  
Irina falls in love with him as if it were already set in place.

But why?  
Why do I feel empty somewhere even though our hearts are connected?  
Why do you look so distressed?

“You said you wanted me to be happy.”

So do I.  
I want you to be happy too.
